title: Dark Echos
description: Deep Dark Dimension And MANY new Deep Dark Items. Be aware that the file is brownie cow however that should be changed when beta ends
body:
The Dark Echos Dimension, A long forgotten place full of long lost souls.
# Portal
Build a portal of Sculk Catylests! Same shape as a Nether Portal.

# Structure

**Prison**, Whoever is meant to be kept here has escaped. Be careful. The prison has only 1 cell, but for good reason. Very evil Mobs are kept here, worse then the wither. The Warden is in charge of all of these prisons, so it is dangerous to even be close to them. Some dead mobs have redeemed themselves and became guards.

# Biomes
**Traped Despair**, Dead Mobs go here when they die again.
**Warden's Office**, The Warden's Castle...be careful. It lives here...
